{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''Fex-M3 canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. Filled with the [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]] [[Fex-M3/Legends|Fex-M3]], it could be used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] targets.
